evidence.reason: At the tip, run() reads the live config at line 726 and measures repair.cq_bin with measure_cq_bin() at line 727, then proceeds through the rollback-compatibility guard and into the admission hold without ever requiring that a configured absolute repair.cq_bin path exists. A missing entry is merely recorded as exists=False, so preflight and the later post-drain equality check both accept it; only after the switch does runtime_pointer_check reject it, and because the prior config carries the same missing entry the rollback cannot satisfy that check either, leaving triggers stopped. This is an implementation gap in the existing pre-admission/fail-closed and rollback guarantees (the same class as the surrounding pre-hold guards), not a request for new protection scope. The smallest fix is an added preflight require for a non-placeholder pointer to name an existing entry, while keeping the later runtime/equality checks to catch post-preflight deletion. No history commit changes this behavior (070cc33 concerns rollback compatibility, and 1faf6c6 removes guards).
